test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I hope you __break a leg__ at your performance tonight!
solution: The correct answer is **Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"break a leg"** is an idiom that means to wish someone good luck. (किसी को शुभकामनाएं देने के लिए प्रयुक्त एक मुहावरा) • **Example:** Before the big show, everyone told the actor to **break a leg.** • **Perform well** refers to executing a task or role at a high standard. (अच्छा प्रदर्शन करना) • **Example:** The students are expected to** perform well** in their examinations. • Hence, we can infer that the phrase **"break a leg"** is a way to wish someone to perform well. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Perform well**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Give up** (त्याग देना): To stop trying or to surrender. • **Example:** She decided not to** give up** despite the difficulties. • **Make a mistake** (गलती करना): To do something incorrectly or inaccurately. • **Example:** It’s natural to **make a mistake** when you’re learning something new. • **Hurt yourself** (स्वयं को चोट पहुंचाना): To cause physical pain or injury to oneself. • **Example:** Be careful with that knife, or you might **hurt yourself.** 1db:Td1f, The correct answer is **Option 4)**
